## D.11 Self-optimization two-iteration law

```text
ITERATION 1
sense
→ measured bottleneck
→ bounded hypotheses
→ cheap screens
→ correctness gate
→ usefulness/performance gate
→ promote/reject
→ receipt + positive/negative science
→ update priors

ITERATION 2
MUST be selected partly from evidence produced by iteration 1.
A prewritten second task does not prove self-optimization.
```
